subject: website
name: Moon Over Negril
summary: A retreat sanctuary site in Negril, Jamaica: plain HTML, CSS and a short readable script, served as written, so the page is its own public source (no licence file). It runs no third-party code and loads only its own files on every page, so it makes no request beyond the site itself. Its forms only open a WhatsApp link when the visitor submits, a step the user takes outside the site.
